payload.text: 0083 (L, dc's issue, approved by vc), menuz's part of item 4 and its tests (vc, 19 Oct 09:04Z): on Linux, edit without --editor, validate, render, build, test, install, uninstall, start, stop and restart refuse by name through common.sh's refuse_off_macos (exit 2, naming the app or Xcode, and what works here); status and doctor print one platform line; init, use, log and stamps run as today. menuz's suites keep testing the macOS paths under a uname stub as Darwin, and add the Linux refusals under a stub Linux, red first, under bash 3.2 and 5; shellcheck 0.9.0; kovacs's loop. menuz's version is mine to set.
